page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon virtual CPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power without a massive memory footprint. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for tasks such as batch processing, web serving, and application servers. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads relying entirely on network-attached storage and CPU-bound execution.
